Executed 22 of 35 test cases against the 5 entities present in the qa tenant. The headline finding is SN-10-BE001: POST /core/api/v1/entities returns HTTP 500 for a payload that returned 201 on 2026-05-28 -- a server-side regression that blocks all entity creation. Because creation is down, 11 TCs are BLOCKED (creation, RunGroup invariants, edit, deactivate) and the fresh PRIMARY / SECONDARY / MULTI_RG test data the suite needs cannot be built. Read-only checks confirmed several SNOPS fixes (lock icon, AUTO badges, Date Format, MY/ID Soon badge) but also surfaced that the v1.2 Payroll Run Groups UI is not implemented and the create form still lacks the Contact Information section (SNOPS-19).

Defects Identified

11 distinct defects ranked P1/P2/P3. None filed in Jira yet ("To file"). Click an affected TC to jump to its detail.

#1 SN-10-BE001 P1 SNOPS-61 FIXED 2026-06-01

SN-10-BE001 -- Entity CREATE API returns HTTP 500 for valid payload (regression)

POST /core/api/v1/entities returns an empty-body HTTP 500 for the exact payload shape that returned 201 on 2026-05-28 (same user, fresh valid bearer, valid entityAdminEmployeeId re-fetched from Test TH Regional). GET endpoints on the same token/tenant return 200, so auth is valid -- the failure is isolated to the create handler. No entity can be created via API or UI; this blocks tenant onboarding and the entire create test path.

#4 SN-10-FE002 P2 SNOPS-19 STILL OPEN 2026-06-01

SN-10-FE002 -- Create form missing "Contact Information" section

Spec ENT-9.1 calls for a "Contact Information" section (HR Admin employee-search autocomplete, HR Contact Email, HR Contact Phone). The form instead has an "Entity Admin Information" section with a plain-text "Name" field. That string is serialized to contactJson.hrAdminId, which is NOT the entityAdminEmployeeId GUID the API requires -- the Name->hrAdminId mismatch contributed to the create failures. Matches open defect SNOPS-19.

#9 SN-10-BE002 P2 To file NEW 2026-06-01

SN-10-BE002 -- Server-side registration validation not enforced (found on 2026-06-01 retest)

With CREATE working again, the API accepts invalid registration values that spec ENT-8.1 defines with strict patterns: tax_id = "12345" (5 digits, expected ^\d{13}$) -> HTTP 201; branch_number = "123" (expected ^\d{5}$) -> 201; short_code = "AB" (2 chars, min 3) -> 201. Invalid Thai tax IDs / branch numbers can be persisted; the API contract is not enforced server-side. Previously masked by the CREATE 500.

Affected Test Cases

#10 SN-10-BE004 P2 To file NEW 2026-06-01

SN-10-BE004 -- RunGroup invariants not enforced; run_groups silently dropped (extends SNOPS-63 to BE)

Sending runGroups[] in the create payload returns 201 but GET on the created entity returns no run_groups -- the field is silently dropped. All invariant-violating variants also returned 201: empty array, two is_default:true, duplicate names, invalid cadence enum (FORTNIGHTLY). Confirms RunGroup (spec v1.2) is unimplemented on the backend, not just the FE.

#11 SN-10-BE003 P3 To file NEW 2026-06-01

SN-10-BE003 -- short_code server rule is pre-v1.1 (uppercase-only)

Lowercase short_code rejected with "ShortCode must be uppercase alphanumeric only." (HTTP 400). Spec v1.1 loosened the rule to 3-12 chars, A-Z + a-z + 0-9 + hyphen (case-insensitive uniqueness). The BE enforces the old v1.0 rule. Exact-duplicate short_code correctly returns 409. Ties to SN-10-FE006 (FE helper text).

Discovery Findings

1. CREATE regression (SN-10-BE001). Same payload that created "QA API Demo Bangkok" (201) on 2026-05-28 now returns 500 with an empty body. GETs succeed on the same token -- isolated to the create handler.

2. Two-layer failure on create. Even before the 500, the FE never surfaces backend errors (SN-10-FE001) -- the create path fails silently end-to-end.

3. v1.2 not shipped in FE. Payroll Run Groups (the headline v1.2 amendment) is absent from both the create form and the detail panel.

4. GET-with-Content-Type 400. Sending Content-Type: application/json on a GET (no body) returns 400 (serializer error) -- same REST-hygiene issue as SN-26-BE003.

5. Per-terminal Playwright profile works. This run used PW_TERMINAL=1 -> .pw-profiles/1, resolving the cross-terminal "Browser is already in use" lock. The profile-1 browser dropped twice under the entities-list polling loop -- a stability concern unrelated to SN-10 functionality.

Recommendations

  1. File SN-10-BE001 (P1) immediately -- entity creation is fully down in qa. Capture the server stack trace behind the empty 500.
  2. File SN-10-FE001 (P1) -- surface BFF 4xx/5xx on the create form (toast + field-level errors).
  3. Land the v1.2 Payroll Run Groups UI (SN-10-FE003).
  4. Add the Contact Information section with HR Admin employee-search autocomplete resolving to entityAdminEmployeeId (SN-10-FE002 / SNOPS-19).
  5. Reconcile the market list between filter pills and create dropdown; remove/guard Vietnam (SN-10-FE005).
  6. Provision E2E_TEST_ENTITY_ADMIN_USERNAME to unblock TC-031.
  7. Re-run /qa-test run SN-10 after BE001 is fixed -- the 11 BLOCKED TCs become executable once create returns 201.
